title: Resolution declaring October Hindu American Awareness Month
summary: This resolution declares October as Hindu American Awareness and Appreciation Month in New York City. It recognizes the contributions of Hindu Americans to the city's economy, culture and neighborhoods, and notes similar recognitions by the U.S. House of Representatives, New York State Senate and California State Assembly. It cites Pew Research Center data that about 2 percent of adults in the New York City metropolitan area identify as Hindu.
